item.title: Israel approves sweeping death penalty legislation targeting terrorism, EU condemns move
item.summary: Israel's Knesset voted to mandate the death penalty for terrorists convicted of deadly attacks, a shift lawmakers say was driven by the horrors of the Oct. 7 massacre.

item.title: Michigan Senate candidate responds to backlash over Khamenei comments, calls Iran conflict ‘war we don’t need’
item.summary: Abdul El-Sayed, one of three Democrats seeking a Michigan Senate seat, responds to backlash over Iran remarks by citing war costs and rising gas prices for Americans.

item.title: Lawmaker says Iran targeted him in phishing attack disguised as TV interview
item.summary: Rep. Randy Fine said an Iranian state actor likely carried out a recent cyberattack on his office in an effort to gain access to his personal Gmail account.

item.title: WWE NXT star Sol Ruca readies for emotional match against Zaria at Stand & Deliver
item.summary: Sol Ruca and Zaria's feud will come to a head on Saturday night at NXT Stand & Deliver as their close friendship has fractured over the last few months.

item.title: Trump admin moves Forest Service HQ to Utah in latest DC relocation push
item.summary: The USDA announced the Forest Service will move its headquarters to Salt Lake City, Utah, replacing regional offices with 15 state directors nationwide.

item.title: Astros player swings and misses at three pitches, walks on ball three as everyone forgets the count
item.summary: The Houston Astros benefited from a bizarre scoring error as Cam Smith walked despite whiffing on three pitches, highlighting a rare counting mishap that went unnoticed by everyone.

item.title: Trump makes historic SCOTUS appearance for birthright citizenship case
item.summary: President Donald Trump is making a historic appearance at the Supreme Court on Wednesday to listen in as the justices weigh his executive order to curb birthright citizenship.

item.title: Colorado climber plunges 30 feet after gear 'failed' scaling mountainside, rescuers say
item.summary: Colorado Springs firefighters spent nearly three hours rescuing a climber, who wasn't wearing a helmet, after his gear failed and he fell 30 feet down a mountainside.

item.title: Benjamin Hall reveals the hidden stories behind America’s most sacred, iconic churches
item.summary: From New Orleans' oldest Roman Catholic cathedral to the Naval Academy chapel, a new series uncovers the powerful history and faith behind America's most sacred and storied houses of worship.

item.title: Islamic activist organization demands Democratic senator apologize for recent Bill Maher appearance
item.summary: CAIR penned a letter demanding Michigan Sen. Elissa Slotkin apologize for recently appearing on "Real Time with Bill Maher" without denouncing his views.
